notes_for_other_devs: Dev-2: the advisory lock in tests/helpers/db.ts applyMigrations serialises migration-vs-migration only; a second worker's plain test query (e.g. the RLS file's DELETE FROM buyers, which locks buyers then reads profiles through the policy) can cross the first worker's migration transaction (holds profiles via REVOKE/ALTER, wants buyers) and Postgres reports a deadlock. Setting `test.fileParallelism: false` in vitest.config.ts (or running the whole file under the same advisory lock) would remove the race. vitest.config.ts is not in the ownership map, so I did not touch it.

Dev-2: no change needed in 0003 for A3; 0003's REVOKE ALL / GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE block and the sequence/generator revokes remain the normalising step and still pass ci:tenant-check after 0001 re-runs.
